title: Sources: AppLovin is among companies in talks to acquire ad tech company Criteo, which has a ~$1B market cap after its stock fell 50%+ over the past five years (Milana Vinn/Reuters)
summary: Milana Vinn / Reuters: Sources: AppLovin is among companies in talks to acquire ad tech company Criteo, which has a ~$1B market cap after its stock fell 50%+ over the past five years — US advertising technology firm AppLovin (APP.O) is among the companies in talks to acquire smaller Paris-based peer Criteo …
